crossRefs.note: Now Yahweh’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahweh troubled him.
You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you…
Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and…
“It will happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king will perish, along with the heart of the…
that they may lack bread and water, be dismayed one with another, and pine away in their iniquity.
There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of…
men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens…
‘Behold, you scoffers, and wonder, and perish; for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe…
even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

parallels.note: In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will strike every horse with terror, and his rider with madness; and I will open my eyes…

translations.web: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
translations.bsb: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness, and confusion of mind,
translations.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
translations.asv: Jehovah will smite thee with madness, and with blindness, and with astonishment of heart;
